experiment: X-ray crystal structure of CaM-CaMBD2-b (1.9 Å) compared with CaM-CaMBD2-a (1G4Y) and CaM-edema factor (1K90): C-lobe, linker and EF-hand loop superpositions
buffer: Tris-HCl 10 mM, NaCl 50 mM, CaCl2 10 mM (gel-filtration buffer of the complex used for crystallization)
ligand_or_partner: Ca2+-bound; SK2-b calmodulin-binding domain (CaMBD2-b, with C-terminal His-tag) in a 2×2 complex
construct_or_mutation: Full-length rat CaM (cDNA in pET-28b) complexed with SK2-b CaMBD; the entry is the C-terminal fragment (entry position 1 = CaM D78), so this is a larger construct
other_conditions: related structures: 1G4Y, 1K90. Residue numbering: CaM numbering = entry position + 77. C-lobe r.m.s.d. 2.53 Å between complexes; N-lobe 0.86 Å; linker 4.83 Å; EF-hand 3 and 4 loop r.m.s.d. 1.28 Å and 1.67 Å (1.96 Å and 2.46 Å with side chains). Crystallization details are in the Supplemental Experimental Procedures, not in the text provided. Residues come from the C-lobe hydrophobic pocket lists and EF-hand loop positions in the text.
dynamics_type: target-induced conformational plasticity of the C-lobe hydrophobic interface and EF-hand loops, coupled to Ca2+ binding (static structural comparison)
alt_state_structure: 3SJQ: CaM with all four EF-hands Ca2+-occupied, rigid linker helix and "S"-like configuration, bound to CaMBD2-b (Results, Structure of the CaM-CaMBD2-b complex)
author_claim: Depending on which SK2 splice variant CaM binds, its C-lobe hydrophobic interface and EF-hand loops rearrange, so the C-lobe is either Ca2+-bound or Ca2+-free, making CaM a dynamic Ca2+ sensor.
anchor: In contrast, the CaM C-lobe shows dramatic differences between the two complexes (r.m.s.d. = 2.53 Å).
locator: Results, Structure of the CaM-CaMBD2-b complex; Figures 1, 5, 6; conditions: Experimental Procedures, Protein Expression and Purification
caveat_note: This compares two static crystal structures made with different CaMBD peptides (b has the ARK insertion), so the differences are target-induced states and not measured exchange between states. No rate, population or NMR relaxation is reported, and the C-lobe motions of free CaM in the entry's window are not tested. The authors say crystal packing does not cause the EF-hand 3 and 4 differences, but this is only stated. The 1G4Y comparison structure is from earlier work.

experiment: AEDANS fluorescence Ca2+-dependent binding assay of CaM(T34C or T110C) with CaMBD2-a or CaMBD2-b
buffer: HEPES 20 mM, NaCl 100 mM, EGTA 10 mM, HEDTA 10 mM, TCEP 0.2 mM
ligand_or_partner: CaMBD2-b compared with CaMBD2-a, over a range of free Ca2+ concentrations
construct_or_mutation: AEDANS-labeled CaM(T34C) or CaM(T110C), 0.2 µM, with 3 µM CaMBD; T110C lies in the entry C-lobe fragment at entry position 33
other_conditions: Apparent Kd for Ca2+ is 0.53 ± 0.04 µM (n = 7) for CaM-CaMBD2-a and 1.18 ± 0.10 µM (n = 4) for CaM-CaMBD2-b; Hill coefficient 1.13 ± 0.04 for CaMBD2-a and 2.05 ± 0.18 for CaMBD2-b. At 10 µM Ca2+ the EC50 is 0.15 ± 0.02 µM (CaMBD2-a) and 0.18 ± 0.01 µM (CaMBD2-b). At 0.3 µM Ca2+ the EC50 is 0.72 ± 0.09 µM for CaMBD2-a, and CaMBD2-b gave little change. Mixtures were incubated 3 h at room temperature.
dynamics_type: ligand-coupled change in Ca2+ affinity (equilibrium binding; no kinetics)
author_claim: CaM complexed with CaMBD2-b has a reduced affinity for Ca2+ compared with CaMBD2-a, consistent with the structural rearrangement of the C-lobe.
anchor: There is, however, a significant rightward shift of the dose-response curve for the Ca 2+ -dependent formation of the CaM-CaMBD2-b complex
locator: Results, CaM as a dynamic Ca2+ sensor; Figure 7A-B; conditions: Experimental Procedures, Fluorescence measurements with fluorophore-labeled CaM
caveat_note: The assay reports complex formation through a labeled-CaM fluorescence signal, so the shift is not assigned to a specific lobe. The authors note that it could in principle come from either lobe or from the affinity of Ca2+-bound CaM for the peptide, and test the second possibility with peptide titrations. They report the MD thermodynamic-integration result (N-lobe more stable than C-lobe, ΔΔG 18.39 ± 6.35 kcal/mol) as a separate argument. This is an equilibrium measurement of full-length CaM with a peptide, not a dynamics measurement in the entry's window.
